result.summary: Found 3 issues: content in the horizontal 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the screen edge, and there are minor layout/consistency issues with cards and category filters extending beyond visible bounds.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with its name and delivery fee truncated and not fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll containers clearly indicate more content is available, or adjust card widths/padding so text isn't abruptly cut off at the viewport edge.

issues.description: The category filter pills (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) are cut off at the right edge, suggesting there are more categories that aren't fully indicated to the user.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient effect or partial visible next item to indicate scrollability of the filter row.

issues.description: The pizza promotional image at the bottom of the screen is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar without a clear visual transition.
issues.suggestion: Add spacing or a fade effect above the navigation bar so content doesn't appear to be sharply clipped.
